decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered out the numerous accessories (cases, power cords, battery bases) to focus on actual Bluetooth speakers. My consideration set includes a high-end brand-name portable speaker (JBL Go 3), a feature-rich budget option (EDUPLINK), a rugged high-output speaker (HyperGear), a highly-rated novelty mini speaker (My Audio Pet), and a versatile night light/speaker combo (MRCOOL). I ultimately chose the JBL Go 3 because it has the highest reliability rating (4.7) from a reputable audio brand and represents the best balance of portability, sound quality, and price for general outdoor/indoor use.
